name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.41.0: Explain settings in the client, on a help screen SELECT opens; Make the help press and its keycap agree in every section state.
changelog.v2.40.0: Ask a router for the messages the Brick missed; Stop dating a replay by when it was fetched.
changelog.v2.39.0: Send reactions and threaded replies, not just read them; The tapback picker owns the body, so no banner may shorten it.
changelog.v2.38.0: List, share and withdraw the mesh's shared places; Honour a dated expiry, and let the places follow the radio.
changelog.v2.37.0: Mark a message's delivery state instead of spelling it.
